semantic.justification: Task130 provides real shared docmodel ComplexColor state needed by native SvxColorItem and border attributes. Original representation/system/theme enums, scalar and raw component states, actual Color last/final ownership, default/copy/assignment/conditional assignment, theme usage, value-return and RGB-only output-reference forms, copied ordered transformation vectors, transparency scan, equality and original hash field sequence are implemented. The native implicit constructor/assignment and source value bodies are co-located in their header owner as a TS language adaptation, without a second declaration or prototype patch. Existing shared Tools Color and o3tl are reused; ordinary JS arrays/values model vector copies, with no allocator/refcount/library reconstruction. Browser32 logical scalar hashes use the existing explicit integer identity binding; component APIs admit native signed32 inputs or Color bytes, so states are integral. Native std::hash<double>/size_t ABI bit patterns are not reproduced or certified. Native equality omits usage and final color, hash includes final and omits theme index; CALC-113 retains and documents this potential inconsistency. All effect table cells and original theme-effect construction are preserved. getIndexForLuminance consumes only normalized HSL luminance, computed with the exact native extrema/order using ordinary Math.min/Math.max; no unused BColor/geometry hierarchy is reconstructed. Native transformation application remains absent until real Tools tint/luminance prerequisites, with no identity fallback. Native UNO complex-color wrapper, SvxColorItem, true DocPool/document/UI/same-model ODS are still pending; this is real value ownership, not a fake empty theme/config peer or full QA claim. Existing browser I/O/recovery deviations remain; no C++/memory/ABI experiment and no full regression before actual minimum UI/ODS readiness.
